text: Last video proved Gold resolves current status by when an event arrived at Kafka, not by when it actually happened. Today we fix that, and make sure it can't quietly come back.
The window function ordered on kafka_ingest_timestamp. A routine re-scan, buffered during a signal gap, arrived forty minutes late and outranked the real, on-time delivery.
The fix orders on the scan's own event_timestamp instead, with arrival time demoted to a tiebreaker. Rerunning Gold, the real package now resolves to delivered -- matching Fabric exactly.
A new test fabricates this exact out-of-order pattern on purpose, and it's wired straight into last video's CI pipeline -- so this specific mistake can't silently ship again.
The bug is found, fixed, tested, and backfilled. Next: formally reconciling every number before anyone else trusts it.
